mapper.select:
select prd.snap_item_name as item_name, prd.snap_kind as kind, prd.snap_unit_name as unit_name, prd.snap_supplier_name as supplier_name, prd.quantity, prd.snap_unit_price as unit_price, prd.subtotal_excluding_tax from purchase_request_detail prd join purchase_request pr on prd.pr_id = pr.pr_id where prd.pr_id = #{prId}
and pr.requester_user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert:
insert into purchase_request_detail ( pr_id, line_no, item_id, snap_item_name, snap_kind, unit_id, snap_unit_name, supplier_id, snap_supplier_name, quantity, snap_unit_price, subtotal_excluding_tax ) values
( #{detail.prId}, #{detail.lineNo}, #{detail.itemId}, #{detail.snapItemName}, #{detail.snapKind}, #{detail.unitId}, #{detail.snapUnitName}, #{detail.supplierId}, #{detail.snapSupplierName}, #{detail.quantity}, #{detail.snapUnitPrice}, #{detail.subtotalExcludingTax} )

update.foreach:
merge into purchase_request_detail as t using( values( #{detail.prDetailId}, #{detail.prId}, #{detail.lineNo}, #{detail.itemId}, #{detail.snapItemName}, #{detail.snapKind}, #{detail.unitId}, #{detail.snapUnitName}, #{detail.supplierId}, #{detail.snapSupplierName}, #{detail.quantity}, #{detail.snapUnitPrice}, #{detail.subtotalExcludingTax} ) ) as s ( pr_detail_id, pr_id, line_no, item_id, snap_item_name, snap_kind, unit_id, snap_unit_name, supplier_id, snap_supplier_name, quantity, snap_unit_price, subtotal_excluding_tax )
on t.pr_detail_id = s.pr_detail_id when matched then update
quantity = #{detail.quantity}, line_no = #{detail.lineNo}, subtotal_excluding_tax = #{detail.subtotalExcludingTax},
snap_item_name = #{detail.snapItemName}, snap_kind = #{detail.snapKind}, supplier_id = #{detail.supplierId}, snap_supplier_name = #{detail.snapSupplierName}, unit_id = #{detail.unitId}, snap_unit_name = #{detail.snapUnitName}, snap_unit_price = #{detail.snapUnitPrice}
when not matched then insert ( pr_id, line_no, item_id, snap_item_name, snap_kind, unit_id, snap_unit_name, supplier_id, snap_supplier_name, quantity, snap_unit_price, subtotal_excluding_tax ) values ( #{detail.prId}, #{detail.lineNo}, #{detail.itemId}, #{detail.snapItemName}, #{detail.snapKind}, #{detail.unitId}, #{detail.snapUnitName}, #{detail.supplierId}, #{detail.snapSupplierName}, #{detail.quantity}, #{detail.snapUnitPrice}, #{detail.subtotalExcludingTax} )
